data.name: Akruti
data.gender_notes: Akruti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akruti is a divine being, the creator of the universe, who assumes various forms and brings the cosmic plan into existence. The name Akruti carries the meaning “Divine Creativity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akruti usually hope their child will grow to embody divine creativity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Manifestation of divine creativity in one's life.
data.etymology: Akruti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Creativity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akruti total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Akruti" holds great reverence in Hindu mythology. Akruti is the Creatress or the Primal Mother Goddess, who brought the cosmic plan into existence. She is the divine power behind all creation and assumes various forms to manifest the will of the divine. This name emphasizes the importance of creation and the role of the divine Mother in shaping the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Akruti represents the divine creative force, the energy that infuses life into matter and gives it form and purpose. It is a symbol of the boundless power of the Divine Mother to bring new life and opportunities into being. The name evokes a sense of awe and reverence for the divine power that pervades all creation and inspires a deeper appreciation for the intricacies of the cosmos.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Akruti symbolizes the active divine primal energy, the cosmic power of manifestation and creation. It embodies the fearless and unstoppable force of the universe, bringing transformation and growth.

vedic_reference.note: Akruti is the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology. She is the goddess of action and execution. She is also known as the goddess of performance and execution of tasks.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Akruti is a goddess in Hinduism, mentioned in the Mahabharata and the Puranas. The name Akruti carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Akruti is a goddess of creation, and is often depicted as the mother of the universe.
